query:
SELECT r.id AS file_reference_id,
                   o.storage_backend,
                   o.object_key,
                   o.mime_type,
                   o.size_bytes,
                   o.checksum_sha256,
                   o.metadata as "metadata: serde_json::Value",
                   o.created_at,
                   o.validated_at
            FROM file_references r
            JOIN file_objects o
              ON o.storage_backend = r.storage_backend
             AND o.object_key = r.object_key
            WHERE r.id = $1
              AND r.released_at IS NULL
